# opentel-mcp — full documentation text

This file is a build-time fallback only. The real, current
llms-full.txt is generated fresh on every `pnpm build` by
scripts/generate-llms-full.js, which overwrites this file's copy in
out/ with the full text of all 12 site pages. If you're reading this
version instead, it means public/ is being served directly without a
build having run — see out/llms-full.txt (or https://opentel-mcp-site.pages.dev/llms-full.txt
once deployed) for the real content.
